battle.name: 李晟收復長安之戰
battle.brief: 興元元年十月，招討使李晟自河中出發，繞關中西南山道，與朱泚叛軍戰於長安城西灃水，斬獲數千；十一月官軍入城，朱泚出奔坊州，旋為部將所殺。卡面所配羅馬短劍並非唐軍制式，唐軍近戰主力是環首刀與唐刀，但短兵相接靠盾緣咬合與刺突節奏的原理，與灃水畔列陣抵接相通。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 交戰兩方是唐廷與朱泚在關中建立的「大燕」叛軍。唐方由兩套指揮系統併成：其一是京師神策軍與禁軍，由觀軍容使魚朝恩節制，負責宿衛與追擊；其二是興元元年新設的招討軍，朝廷以檢校太尉、中書令李晟為招討使，隴右渾部出身的渾瑊為副元帥，宦官尚可紀為監軍，軍令出自鳳翔行在所，再由尚書省下符移給河中、鄜坊、昭應各鎮。河中節度使韓游瓊所部忠武軍是李晟大軍的骨幹與後勤基地，據河中控扼蒲津，東可援同華，西可進臨渭水；鄜坊節度使張懷瓘奉詔與李晟合兵，扼守坊、鄜，斷叛軍北走的道路。叛軍方面，主體是涇原兵變時隨朱泚入京的涇原鎮兵，兵數數千，其後裹挾關中降卒、坊郭游兵與被募之徒，號稱大軍；朱泚以涇原舊將姚令言為尚書令總攝軍政，河北、河南各鎮叛軍多遣使奉偽號來歸，與之連兵。吐蕃自隴右南下，一度遣兵助朱泚並遣使通聘，成為雙方拉鋒的第三方。
countriesEn: The two parties in this battle were the Tang court and the rebel state of Great Yan that Zhu Ci had raised in Guanzhong. On the Tang side two command systems were joined together. The first was the imperial capital establishment, the Divine Strategy Army and the palace guard, under Yu Chao'en, who held the office of Supervisor of Army Capacity and Combat Affairs, responsible for the defence of the capital and for pursuit. The second was the Army of the Pacification newly created in the first year of Xingyuan: the court appointed Li Sheng, who held the concurrent posts of Grand Commander of the Army and Minister of the Secretariat, as Commissioner for Pacification; Hun Jian, a general of the Hun tribe of Longyou, as deputy commander; and the eunuch Shang Keji as supervisor of the army. The orders came out of the travelling court at Fengtian and were then transmitted by the Department of State Affairs in the form of tally slips to the circuits of Hedong, Fufang and Zhaoying. The troops of Han Youqiong, military governor of Hedong and commander of the Loyal and Martial Army, formed the backbone and the supply base of Li Sheng's army; by holding Hedong they controlled the crossing at Puzhong, able to reinforce Tong and Hua to the east and to press down towards the Wei on the west. Zhang Huaiguan, military governor of Fufang, was ordered to join forces with Li Sheng, holding Fang and Fu so as to cut off the road by which the rebels might run north. On the rebel side the main body was the Jingyuan garrison soldiers who had entered the capital with Zhu Ci when the Jingyuan mutiny broke out, some five thousand men; they afterwards absorbed surrendered troops from Guanzhong, run-of-the-town fighters from the city wards and men who had been press-ganged, and claimed to be a great host. Zhu Ci set up Yao Lingyan, an old Jingyuan officer, as Minister of the Works to direct military administration in general, and the rebels of the circuits of Hebei and Henan sent envoys bearing false titles to attach themselves to him and fight in concert. Tibet, descending from Longyou, at one point sent troops to aid Zhu Ci and sent envoys with gifts, and became a third party whose weight was felt by both sides.
people: 李晟是此役的主帥，字良器，出身河朔軍門，先在魏博、忠武諸鎮作戰，涇原兵變時已自河中起兵勤王，因兵力單薄而未能直趨京師，興元元年受命為招討使後長期屯聚河中，蓄勢不發，等敵師疲。他最大的功績是把一次會戰打成一次戰役：以招撫吐蕃諸部、取得山道嚮導換取兼程行軍，令唐軍自關中西南的山道迂迴而出，避開叛軍倚重的潼關與渭橋正面，突然出現在長安城西的灃水南岸。唐德宗李适在涇原兵變時出奔鳳翔，倚李懷光、渾瑊等勤王軍，行在所靠詔書與符節調兵，戰局逆轉後於興元元年十二月還京。朱泚是叛軍的靈魂，幽州出身，涇原節度使，兵變入京後殺拒諫的涇原別將段秀實，旋進位大燕皇帝、建元應天，晚年失人心，兵敗出奔坊州，為部將李崇信等人所殺，首級傳送京師。姚令言是叛軍的總帥，統兵在醴泉一線拒戰，兵敗後為自己部屬所疑所殺，叛軍至此失去一名能打的宿將。副元帥渾瑊出身吐蕃渾部，是唐軍中少數熟稔隴西山地的將領；監軍尚可紀以宦官身份隨軍，與神策軍觀軍容使魚朝恩同為皇帝派在陣前的耳目，事後唐廷削藩失策、宦官監軍愈演愈烈，削弱了將領的自主權與指揮效率。河中節度使韓游瓊供給軍糧甲兵，鄜坊節度使張懷瓘在北線與李晟合兵，而李懷光本人在收復長安之後旋即叛唐，成為此役之後唐廷最棘手的亂源。
peopleEn: Li Sheng was the commander in chief of this campaign. His courtesy name was Liangqi; he came out of a military family of Heshuo and had first served in the circuits of Weibo and in the Loyal and Martial Army. When the Jingyuan mutiny broke out he had already raised troops in Hedong to serve the court, but his force was too thin to march straight upon the capital; after receiving his appointment as Commissioner for Pacification in the first year of Xingyuan he stayed for a long while massed at Hedong, gathering strength without striking, waiting for the enemy to tire. His greatest achievement was turning a single engagement into a whole campaign: by winning over the Tibetan tribes and obtaining guides for the mountain roads, he bought the right to march at the double pace, so that the Tang army came out by the roads of the southwest of Guanzhong, avoided the Tong Pass and the main bridge over the Wei on which the rebels relied, and appeared suddenly on the south bank of the Feng river west of Chang'an. Emperor Dezong, Li Shu, had fled to Fengtian at the time of the Jingyuan mutiny and leaned on Li Huaigu, Hun Jian and the other troops that came to the court's aid; the travelling court moved soldiers only by rescript and by tally, and when the battle turned, it was back in the capital in the twelfth month of the first year of Xingyuan. Zhu Ci was the soul of the rebel army. A native of Youzhou and military governor of Jingyuan, he killed Duan Xiushi, a Jingyuan officer who refused to recognise him, after entering the capital, then took the throne of Great Yan with the era name Yingtian; late in his reign he had lost the confidence of his men, and after his defeat he fled towards Fangzhou and was killed by his own commanders, Li Chongxin among them, his head sent to the capital. Yao Lingyan was the commander in chief of the rebels, leading the field against the court troops on the Lichuan line; after his defeat he was killed by his own subordinates, who had already begun to suspect him, and the rebels thereby lost the one seasoned commander who could still fight. Deputy commander Hun Jian came from the Hun tribe of Tibet and was one of the few Tang generals who knew the country of Longyou. Supervisor Shang Keji marched with the army in the capacity of eunuch, and together with Yu Chao'en, who had charge of the Divine Strategy Army, he was the emperor's own eyes and ears in the field; in the years afterwards the failures of the court's reduction of the regional commands and the growing power of the eunuch supervisors weakened the autonomy of the generals and the efficiency of command. Military governor Han Youqiong of Hedong supplied grain, arms and horses; military governor Zhang Huaiguan of Fufang joined Li Sheng on the northern front; and Li Huaigu himself, who had carried the emperor to Fengtian, rebelled against the Tang shortly after Chang'an was recovered, becoming the most awkward source of trouble the court faced afterwards.
kits: 此役的兵器配置以唐軍的刀、弓、弩為主，與卡面所配的羅馬短劍有清楚的對照關係。唐軍近戰主力是環首刀與唐刀：環首刀為單刃直身、刀首回環成環柄，格擋與劈砍兼顧；雙手直刃唐劍則是儀仗與軍官常佩之物，長槊與矛是步兵列陣的核心，步軍每卒備長槊、環首刀與弓箭，騎兵則佩長刀、弓箭和少量長槊。甲胄以皮甲、札甲與明光甲為主，重裝披甲只配給精騎與軍官。弓弩方面，角弓配箭，臂張弩、蹶張弩供守城與破陣之用，破壞門樓、遮蔽射界靠火矢與火箭，攻堅用撞木、雲梯、鉤索，叛軍則以木拒馬、柵欄和城上的弓箭礮石抵禦。糧秣依河中屯田、關中稅賦與漕運轉輸，李晟行軍刻意貼近運道，兼程時靠沿途屯軍供應。卡面這件羅馬短劍是卡牌編排的代表作：它並非唐軍制式裝備，唐人也不使用雙刃刺劍與圓盾的組合；但在劍的形制源流上，漢晉以來中原的雙刃直刺短劍本與地中海世界的短劍同屬一類短兵相接武器，兩者的戰術邏輯完全相通：短兵相接靠的是盾緣的咬合、腳步的節奏與一記乾淨的刺突，而不是揮砍。收復長安過程中多場貼身格鬥，環首刀與短劍的功用正落在此處。
kitsEn: The weapons of this campaign were centred on the blades, bows and crossbows of the Tang army, and they stand in a clear contrast to the Roman short sword shown on the card. The Tang mainstay in close combat was the ring-pommel dao and the Tang dao: the ring-pommel dao had a single straight blade with the pommel folded back into a ring for the hand, serving both to cut and to block; the two-handed straight-edged Tang sword was the weapon of officers and of ceremonial use; the long shafted lance and the spear were the core of the infantry line, each foot soldier carrying a lance, a ring-pommel dao and a bow, while the cavalry carried long sabres, bows and a few lances. Armour consisted mostly of leather, lacquered scale and bright plate, and the heavy harness went only to the picked cavalry and to officers. For missile weapons there were composite bows with arrows, and bow-arms and crossbows for siege work and for breaking formations; fire arrows and incendiary bolts were used to destroy gate towers and to blind the firing lanes of the defenders; assault used rams, scaling ladders and grappling ropes; and the rebels answered with wooden cheval-de-frise, barricades, and arrows and stones from the walls. Grain came from the fields and the depots of Hedong, from the taxes of Guanzhong and from river transport, and Li Sheng deliberately kept his march close to the supply lines, living off the depots of the towns along the road during the forced march. The Roman gladius on the card is a representative piece chosen for the card: it was not a standard Tang weapon, for the Chinese did not use the combination of a double-edged thrusting sword and a round shield. Yet in the lineage of sword forms the double-edged thrusting shortsword of the Central Plains, which had existed since the Han and Jin dynasties, belonged to the same family of close-quarter weapons as the shortsword of the Mediterranean world, and the tactical logic of the two was identical: close fighting turned on the shield rim biting against the shield rim, on the rhythm of the footwork and on one clean thrust, not on slashing. In the many hand-to-hand struggles that accompanied the recapture of Chang'an, the ring-pommel dao and the short sword did their work in precisely that place.
tactics: 李晟的戰法可以歸納為四步。第一是等：兵變之後叛軍氣盛，鳳翔行在所兵力不足，李晟以河中為基地，屯兵積粟而不急於出擊，等叛軍主力西調、援軍遠離長安，等李懷光與韓游瓊的河中兵與關中諸鎮完成集結，也等糧秣與馬匹補充到能支撐長途奔襲的程度。第二是撫：遣使招撫吐蕃諸部與黨項、吐谷渾部眾，換取嚮導、馬匹與沿途補給，同時用議和、封官的條件離間叛軍與其外圍附勢者。第三是迂：主力取關中西南的山道，自河中南下，過華州，走秦嶺棧道與關西南道，經方渠、醴泉一線西出，繞到長安城西的灃水流域，出叛軍意料；同時派別將自北線沿鄜坊一帶進逼，切斷長安與北地叛軍的聯絡。第四是打：灃水南岸列陣，先以挑釁與小股騎兵試敵，待叛軍出城北向布陣、陣形未合，即以步騎同時壓上，攻其未穩之中堅；叛軍退入長安後人心崩潰，城中有降卒為策應者夜開城門，唐軍入城。守城者退保城樓與宮城，官軍以火矢、撞木破門，逐巷清剿，最後在城郊水際追殲殘部。
tacticsEn: Li Sheng's method can be summed up in four steps. The first was to wait. After the mutiny the rebels were in high spirits and the travelling court at Fengtian was short of troops, so Li Sheng took Hedong as his base, quartering his men and storing grain without striking, waiting for the rebel main force to be drawn west and their reinforcements to be pulled away from Chang'an, waiting for the troops of Li Huaigu and Han Youqiong in Hedong and the contingents of the circuits of Guanzhong to finish assembling, and waiting for the grain and the horses to be replenished to a level that could support a long march and a forced march. The second was to appease. Envoys were sent to win over the Tibetan tribes and the Dangxiang and Tuyuhun peoples, in exchange for guides, horses and supplies along the road, and at the same time terms of peace and of office were used to separate the rebels from the clients that had attached themselves to them. The third was to go round. The main body took the mountain roads of the southwest of Guanzhong, leaving Hedong to the south, passing the prefecture of Hua, using the plank roads of the Qinling and the roads of the southwest of the pass, and coming out westward along the Fangquan and Lichuan line, so as to arrive in the basin of the Feng river west of Chang'an against the rebels' expectations; at the same time separate commands were sent along the Fufang line in the north to press in and cut the rebels off from the northern territories. The fourth was to strike. On the south bank of the Feng the Tang army deployed in line, first provoking the enemy and testing them with small bodies of horse, and when the rebels came out of the city and deployed to the north with their line not yet closed, infantry and cavalry pressed in together and struck the middle of a formation that had not yet found its feet. Driven back into Chang'an, the rebels lost heart, a surrendered soldier inside the city opened the gate by night and the Tang troops entered. The defenders who remained fell back on the towers of the city and on the palace quarter; fire arrows and rams were used against the gates, the fighting went street by street, and the last of the fugitives were run down at the water's edge outside the walls.
data: 可寫的數字有限，只能取有根據者。涇原兵變時入京的涇原兵，《資治通鑑》系以五千上下計，其後裹挾關中兵眾，叛軍總量當在數萬之數，記錄多稱十萬，屬號稱之辭。唐軍方面，招討軍主力號稱十萬上下，其中多為各道勤王兵與河中、鄜坊兩鎮人馬，另有收編的涇原降卒數千、精騎數千，實際戰鬥兵力遠小於號數。地理上，河中至長安直線約六百餘里，迂迴山道行程逾千里。時間上，李晟自興元元年春受命，至十月灃水接戰、十一月入城，歷時約半年有奇；朱泚自稱帝建元應天至兵敗出逃，不到半年；唐德宗自出奔鳳翔到還京，前後近十四個月。灃水一戰，斬獲及溺死者以數千計，通鑑記叛軍死傷甚多，而官軍損失不大。制度面上，天寶末全國置節度使十餘處，每鎮兵額自數萬至十餘萬不等，合計遠超中央禁軍。民生方面，連年兵禍使京兆、坊州一帶人煙凋零，逃戶與流民成為朝廷安置與編查稅籍的難題。
dataEn: The figures that can be given are few, and only those with a basis. The Jingyuan soldiers who entered the capital at the time of the mutiny are put at about five thousand by the Zizhi Tongjian; with the surrendered men of Guanzhong drawn in afterwards, the total of the rebel force was in the tens of thousands, and the records commonly speak of a hundred thousand, which is a figure of proclamation rather than of count. On the Tang side the Army of the Pacification was claimed at about a hundred thousand men, made up mostly of the auxiliaries sent by the circuits to serve the court together with the troops of the circuits of Hedong and Fufang, together with several thousand surrendered Jingyuan soldiers and several thousand picked cavalry; the real fighting strength was far below the proclaimed number. Geographically the direct distance from Hedong to Chang'an is a little over six hundred li, and the circuitous march by the mountain roads exceeded a thousand. In time Li Sheng received his appointment in the spring of the first year of Xingyuan, fought at the Feng in the tenth month and entered the city in the eleventh, a span of a little over half a year; from Zhu Ci's assumption of the imperial title with the era name Yingtian to his flight in defeat was less than half a year; and Emperor Dezong was away from the capital from his flight to Fengtian until his return, close to fourteen months in all. In the battle at the Feng, the killed and the drowned were counted in thousands, the Zizhi Tongjian recording that the rebels suffered heavily while the court army lost little. On the institutional side, by the end of the Tianbao era the empire had more than ten military governorships, each with a quota of troops from several tens of thousands to more than a hundred thousand, so that the circuits together commanded far more men than the central guard. On the demographic side, years of war had thinned the population of the Jingzhao and the Fangzhou region, and the runaway households and the displaced people of Guanzhong became one of the hardest problems of the court in settling them and in checking the tax registers.
cause: 戰爭的根子在唐廷的削藩與邊軍的失養。天寶末安史之亂平後，朝廷在關中、河南、江淮遍設節度使，以藩鎮代朝廷養兵，兵權與財權盡歸其手。德宗初年銳意削藩，又因兩稅法改制、州縣追索，邊軍欠餉、士卒怨望；興元元年秋，朝廷調涇原鎮兵戍守涇水，糧餉不給，又值秋收將熟，涇原兵譁變，劫府庫、推朱泚為首，一路由西北趨京。德宗出奔鳳翔，朱泚入城殺涇原別將段秀實，進位大燕皇帝、建元應天，改元換制、徵發關中丁壯與糧芨，任用姚令言總軍政，並以偽號招納河北、河南各鎮叛軍。李懷光自河中奉迎行在，卻暗通朱泚；李晟等外鎮兵雖屢屢入援，人數既少、號令又不一，難與叛軍正面接戰。朝廷於是改以李晟為招討使，專任收復京畿之責；而叛軍入京已逾一年，關中城府空虛、士氣耗散，正是反攻的窗口。
causeEn: The root of the war lay in the court's attempt to reduce the regional commands and in the failure to feed the frontier troops. After the suppression of the An Lushan rebellion at the end of the Tianbao era the court set up military governorships in Guanzhong, in Henan and on the lower Yangzi, using the commands of the regions to feed and to hold troops in place of the central army, and the power over soldiers and over money passed entirely into their hands. Early in Dezong's reign the court pressed hard to cut them down, and at the same time the reform to the two-tax system and the stricter collection of taxes by the prefectures left the frontier troops unpaid and the soldiers resentful. In the autumn of the first year of Xingyuan the court ordered the Jingyuan garrison to garrison the Jing river; their grain and pay were not provided, and the autumn harvest was about to be taken, so the Jingyuan soldiers mutinied, plundered the depots and put Zhu Ci at their head, and marched from the northwest towards the capital. Dezong fled to Fengtian; Zhu Ci entered the capital and killed Duan Xiushi, a Jingyuan officer who refused to recognise him, then took the throne of Great Yan with the era name Yingtian, changed the calendar and the titles, levied men and stores from Guanzhong, used Yao Lingyan to direct military administration in general, and by means of false titles drew in the rebels of the circuits of Hebei and Henan. Li Huaigu, who had received the travelling court at Hedong, was in secret communication with Zhu Ci; and although the troops of the outer circuits such as Li Sheng's came to the court's aid again and again, they were few in number and their commands were not united, so they could not engage the rebels in a straight battle. The court therefore made Li Sheng Commissioner for Pacification and gave him sole responsibility for recovering the capital region, and by that time the rebels had held the capital for more than a year, the treasuries of Guanzhong were empty and their spirit was spent, which was exactly the moment for a counter-stroke.
impact: 此役的直接後果是關中重歸朝廷，但唐廷的軍制病竈並未因此治好，反倒因它而加深。第一，宦官監軍成為定制。尚可紀隨招討軍出師，魚朝恩掌神策軍觀軍容使，兩個「天使」在陣前直接制約主將，李晟以招討使之尊尚且不時受制於監軍；此後唐代監軍之權愈重，削弱了將領的自主權與指揮效率。第二，藩鎮割據的格局由此定型。朱泚死後，淮西李希烈曾遣使奉偽號於朱泚並自稱帝，吳少誠誅之，淮西自此為唐廷心腹大患；河中李懷光在收復長安之後旋即叛唐，一度進逼鳳翔，德宗再出奔，翌年兵敗授首。收復長安並未削弱方鎮，反而說明朝廷必須依賴方鎮兵才能收復京師。第三，財政與戶籍的重整提上日程，兩稅法的貨幣化使州縣徵收艱難，關中逃戶、流民的編戶齊民，成為貞元初年最棘手的民政問題。第四，軍事技術層面上，此役是唐末以前少數以冷兵器正面會戰配合策應、迂迴奔襲取城的大戰，統籌與機動的價值高於正面硬撼，歷代兵書講「以正合、以奇勝」多引此役為例。
impactEn: The immediate consequence of this campaign was that Guanzhong returned to the court, but the military structure of the Tang did not recover from it; on the contrary the campaign deepened the disease. First, the eunuch supervisor became a regular institution. Shang Keji marched with the Army of the Pacification and Yu Chao'en held the charge of the Divine Strategy Army, and these two emissaries of the emperor in the field constrained the commander directly; Li Sheng, with all the authority of a Commissioner for Pacification, was still checked by the supervisor now and then, and from then on the power of the eunuch supervisors grew heavier, weakening the autonomy of the generals and the efficiency of command. Second, the pattern of the military governorship as an independent power was fixed by this war. After Zhu Ci's death Li Jilie of Huaixi had sent envoys to Zhu Ci bearing false titles and had proclaimed himself emperor; Wu Shaocheng killed him, and Huaixi remained from that point a sore in the side of the court. Li Huaigu of Hedong rebelled shortly after Chang'an was recovered, at one point pressing on towards Fengtian and forcing the emperor to flee again, and he was defeated and beheaded in the following year. The recapture of Chang'an did not weaken the regional commands; it showed rather that the court had to depend on the troops of the regional commands in order to recover its own capital. Third, the reform of the finances and of the registers was put on the agenda: the monetisation of the two-tax system made collection in the prefectures harder, and the settling and registering of the runaway households and displaced people of Guanzhong became the sharpest civil problem of the early Zhenyuan years. Fourth, at the level of military technique this was one of the few great battles before the late Tang in which a pitched engagement in cold weapons was combined with a turning movement and a forced march to take the city; the value of planning and of mobility was higher than that of grinding head-on, and later military treatises that teach the principle of meeting the enemy squarely and winning by surprise take this campaign as their example.
result: 興元元年十月，灃水之戰，李晟乘叛軍陣未整而攻之，斬獲數千，叛軍北潰，屢戰屢敗，退保長安。十月既望，叛軍主將姚令言在醴泉一線兵敗，為己部所疑所殺，朱泚失去了唯一能獨當一面的大將。十一月，官軍進逼長安城下，叛軍內部相繼崩潰，有降卒為策應者夜開城門，唐軍入城；朱泚乘夜率殘部出奔坊州，旋為部將李崇信等所縛，梟首傳京師，餘眾或降或散，關中叛亂至此平定。李晟以軍入長安，朝廷加授檢校太尉、中書令，封幽國公。唐德宗於興元元年十二月自鳳翔還京，下詔罪己、求直言，收復之役告一段落。但亂源未除：李懷光旋以河中叛，兵進鳳翔，朝廷再遣李晟、渾瑊討之，至貞元元年李懷光為部下所殺，淮西李希烈亦稱帝而被誅；自此軍亂與藩鎮之患並列爲唐廷兩大難題，留待後世解決。
resultEn: In the tenth month of the first year of Xingyuan, at the battle of the Feng river, Li Sheng struck while the rebel line was still forming and killed and captured several thousand; the rebels broke to the north, were defeated again and again, and fell back on Chang'an. After the fifteenth of the tenth month the rebel commander Yao Lingyan was defeated on the Lichuan line and killed by his own men, who had grown suspicious of him, and Zhu Ci lost the one great general he could still rely on. In the eleventh month the court troops pressed up against the walls of Chang'an; the rebel command broke down in succession, a surrendered soldier opened the gate by night and acted as a sign for the assault, and the Tang troops entered the city; Zhu Ci fled by night with the remnant of his force towards Fangzhou, was bound by his own commanders, Li Chongxin among them, and his head was sent to the capital, while the rest either surrendered or scattered and the rebellion in Guanzhong was settled. Li Sheng entered the capital with his army, and the court granted him in addition the post of Grand Commander of the Army and Minister of the Secretariat and the title of Duke of You. Emperor Dezong returned to the capital from Fengtian in the twelfth month of the first year of Xingyuan, issued a rescript blaming himself and calling for honest counsel, and the campaign for the recovery of the capital was closed. But the source of the disorder was not removed: Li Huaigu rebelled with Hedong soon after, advanced his troops on Fengtian, and the court sent Li Sheng and Hun Jian against him once more; in the first year of Zhenyuan Li Huaigu was killed by his own subordinates, and Li Jilie of Huaixi, who had also proclaimed himself emperor, was killed as well. From then on the mutinies of the army and the power of the regional commands stood side by side as the two great troubles of the Tang court, left for later generations to solve.
